playstyle: Fast, evasive and pressure-heavy. Poke with quick strings that have many extensions, so the opponent is scared to press, then mix them up from back-turned (BT), Katon (KAT) and Setsunagake (SET). Wavu warns most of her moves lose to sidesteps to her right.

stances.name: Backturn
stances.note: BT.4 is +6 on block; BT.1,4 is a Heat Engager and +3; BT.4,F goes into SET.

stances.name: Katon
stances.note: KAT.1,2 is a Heat Engager; KAT.2 leads to qcf+2 (Wavu mini-combo).

stances.name: Setsunagake
stances.note: SET.2 is i12 and launches on counter hit; SET.1,2,1 tornadoes; SET.1+2 is a Heat Engager.

keyMoves: Fast check and the start of 1,2,2.
i10 punish string (Wavu), -12 if it all finishes on block.
i12 string that goes back-turned, -3 on block.
Her i12 punish and a BT entry.
i17 high, +1 on block; can continue into db+3.
A plus high that keeps the turn.
i15 launcher, launches crouchers too. -14 on block.
Kaede: i15 while-standing launcher, -13 on block.
Fox Toe Smash: i11 while-standing kick, -6 on block.
Hakkouen: i17 mid, -9 on block, +57 on counter hit.
Seneizan: i20 low, -14 on block, +15g on counter hit.
i17 mid Heat Engager, -6 on block.
Secret Flower: parries mid and high punches and kicks.
Mizore: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: Instant tornado: ws2,1 f3+4 BT.4,F SET.1 qcf+1
combos.situation: After an instant tornado such as a low parry (Wavu).
mistakes: Holding F too late after BT.4: SET has to start straight away.
Doing f+3+4 slowly: it turns her back-turned for BT.4.
